import { Callout } from '@/components/docs/docs-callout';

<DocsAgentIndex />

Wave is the primary mobile-money rail for **UEMOA (XOF)** merchants. Most teams should use [hosted checkout](/build/checkout) or [payment links](/build/payment-links) first.

## Hosted checkout (recommended)

1. Create a checkout session with `currency_code: "XOF"`.
2. Customer selects **Wave** on the hosted page.
3. Customer approves in the Wave app.
4. Confirm with webhooks or `GET /transactions/{id}` before fulfilling.

## Direct charge

`POST /charge/wave` requires **XOF**. The response includes `wave_launch_url` or `checkout_url`—redirect or deep-link the customer.

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa/charge/wave" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 1000,
    "currency_code": "XOF",
    "customer_email": "customer@example.com",
    "success_url": "https://example.com/success",
    "cancel_url": "https://example.com/cancel"
  }'
```

See [Charges API](/api/charge/ChargesController_createWaveCharge) and [Direct charges](/build/direct-charges).

## Test vs live

| | Test | Live |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Balance credit | Often when session/charge is created | After customer approves in Wave |
| Status | Usually `completed` quickly | Starts `pending` |

<Callout type="info">
  In live mode, never fulfill on redirect alone. See [Verify payments](/build/guides/verify-payments).
</Callout>

## Payouts

Wave **beneficiary** payouts require a live key and valid recipient phone. Wave self-withdrawals are **live-only**—test keys return `400` for Wave payout rails. See [Sandbox payouts](/start/sandbox-payments#payouts-in-test-mode).
